_doc: Canned worker responses for LOCKED v6. The app POSTs to https://lockedapi.cescocugliari.workers.dev/ with {system, max_tokens, messages} and reads d.content[0].text (source L50063-L50072 request, L50144-L50146 parse; ProactiveTipCard L17904-L17921 and CoachInterview L49772-L49790 use the same shape). Every entry in `replies` is the exact JSON body to return with HTTP 200. Marker blocks (###PLAN_START### etc., L50241-L50260) are parsed out of the same text field, so a plan generation is not a different endpoint, just a reply whose text carries a ###PLAN_START###...###PLAN_END### block.

mapping.description: routeNetwork() first checks the LAST user message in body.messages against `keywords` (case-insensitive substring, first match wins). If none match it returns replies[n % replies.length] where n counts coach chat requests seen so far in the test. The proactive tip (system prompt starts with 'You are a personal coach. Give ONE short') always gets `proactiveTip`. The interview (system prompt contains 'six-question onboarding interview') always gets `interview`.
